name: Chicken sausage & sweet potato breakfast bowl
steps: Roast the diced sweet potato in olive oil until tender.
Slice and brown the chicken sausage in a hot pan.
Fry the egg to your liking in the same pan.
Wilt the spinach in the residual heat.
Layer the sweet potato, sausage and spinach in a bowl.
Top with the fried egg and season to taste.
